title: Verify: Scene hover, click and missing-asset fallback unit tests with Phaser mocked via @game
summary: Suite asserts hover, click and fallback behavior with phaser mocked and @game imports.
description: Context: ACT-C confirmed hover, click and fallback paths. Desired behavior: a suite asserts them through @game with phaser mocked. Expected result: tests pass together with the build suite. Why: proves REQ-C from the spec.
acceptance_criteria: Hover true/false toggles highlight and label
Click emits objectId and actions only when visible
Unknown asset resolves to fallback key and fallback texture is generated
technical_constraints: vi.mock('phaser') and the frontend runtime/store/events/effectContext modules, mirroring tests/preload.test.ts
definition_of_done: test passes; all scene tests pass together

steps.symbol: new: scene interaction and fallback via @game
steps.action: Import SceneObject from '@game/entities/SceneObject', planPreload/resolveTextureKey from '@game/engine/planPreload', FALLBACK_KEY and BootScene from '../frontend/src/phaser/BootScene' with vi.mock('phaser') copied in shape from tests/preload.test.ts. Tests: (1) captured onHover callback(true) then (false) gives setHighlighted/setLabelVisible [[true],[false]]; (2) after sync, captured onClick callback calls listener with objectId and actions, and hidden object calls nothing; (3) resolveTextureKey for unknown id returns FALLBACK_KEY; (4) BootScene.preload with unknown asset ref does not call load.image for it and generates texture FALLBACK_KEY
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/sceneAliasInteraction.test.ts tests/sceneAliasBuild.test.ts
steps.expected: Both scene alias suites pass together
